businesses.business: reservoir description and production enhancement services for oil and gas

offering_description.value: Provides laboratory-based reservoir rock and fluid analysis, core analysis, and production enhancement services to oil and gas operators. Serves national and international oil companies and service firms. Delivers through laboratories, field crews and engineered products such as perforating charges and diagnostics.

primary_products.value: perforating charges and guns; completion diagnostic tools; reservoir fluid sampling equipment

primary_services.value: core analysis; reservoir fluid analysis; crude oil assay and characterization; completion diagnostics; geological and petrophysical consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: national and international oil companies, independent operators, oilfield service companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: laboratory analysis and reservoir studies billed per project or sample; product sales: perforating systems and diagnostic products sold to operators and service companies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs laboratory and field analysis for oil and gas operators; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures perforating charges and diagnostic products for completion service companies and operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Reservoir Description (core and fluid analysis) and Production Enhancement (perforating, diagnostics)

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: technical sales to oil and gas operators and service companies; own locations: network of laboratories and field offices worldwide

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: explosives manufacture and transport (ATF, export controls) and environmental and safety rules for oilfield work
